config.label: Full connection string (preferred)
config.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

config.label: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set)
config.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

config.label: Database port
config.description: Database port.

config.label: Database user
config.description: Database user.

config.label: Database password
config.description: Database password.

config.label: Database name
config.description: Database name.

config.label: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly
config.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

config.label: TLS mode
config.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

config.label: Path to a CA certificate file
config.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

config.label: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching)
config.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

config.label: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model
config.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

config.label: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session
config.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

config.label: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels)
config.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

config.label: SSH bastion host
config.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

config.label: SSH bastion port
config.description: SSH bastion port.

config.label: SSH username
config.description: SSH username.

config.label: Path to a private key file
config.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

config.label: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted
config.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

config.label: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe
config.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

config.label: SSH login password
config.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

config.label: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:
config.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

config.label: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects
config.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.
